name: M2RC-Eval
abstract: M2RC-Eval measures repository-level code completion. This page uses Avg ES from the direct model comparison table as the primary leaderboard and keeps Avg EM as a secondary metric.
contributions: The paper distinguishes repository-level completion from ordinary single-file generation.
To avoid mixing retrieval or training augmentations into the leaderboard, this page shows only direct model baselines.
method: M2RC-Eval targets repository-level code completion rather than isolated function-level completion.
It builds a multilingual benchmark spanning 18 programming languages with fine-grained AST-based annotations.
These annotations cover both bucket-level difficulty and semantic completion scenarios.
The paper also introduces M2RC-INSTRUCT to improve repository-level completion ability.
Its main value is evaluating both cross-language generalization and fine-grained completion behavior.
leaderboard_note: The primary leaderboard metric is Avg ES from Table 2 direct model comparisons. Avg EM is shown as a complementary stricter measure.
